neighbours.label: the first digit of the result of an arithmetic calculation (after '=' or at the end of a worked formula)
fire: Three boxes of 12 eggs at 25 cents each cost 3 x 12 x 0.25 = 9 dollars.
With 6 rows of 40 seats, the hall holds 6 x 40 = 240 people.
The total distance is 55 km/h x 4 h = 220 km.
So the area of the field is 30 m x 70 m = 2100 square metres.
Adding the three fees gives 120 + 45 + 35 = 200 euros.
The energy used is 2 kW x 5 h = 10 kWh per day.
At 8 percent of 450, the tip comes to 0.08 x 450 = 36 dollars.
The mass is density times volume: 2.7 g/cm3 x 10 cm3 = 27 grams.
quiet: Three boxes of eggs arrived on Tuesday, a little later than usual.
